methods.label: Scale the numerator and denominator equally
methods.explanation:
A quotient stays the same when its numerator and denominator are both divided by the same nonzero number. Divide both by \(10\). Since dividing the factor \(7\) by \(10\) divides the whole product \(7\times53\) by \(10\), we obtain
\[
\frac{9}{7\times53}
=\frac{9\div10}{(7\times53)\div10}
=\frac{0.9}{0.7\times53}.
\]
This is choice A.
methods.levelReason: The method uses decimal place value and the elementary quotient invariance rule.

candidate.annotationRationale: The target is recognizing a quotient preserved by equal scaling. Decimal-point movement supplies the factors of ten; the solution applies scaling to the entire denominator rather than treating its two factors independently.
